accounting_contract.do_not_sum: Repeated per_query rows, report generation summaries, old plus compatible artifact summaries, and invocation plus historical summary costs are overlapping views.
accounting_contract.history_vs_incremental: Final record/summary retains the original cost and attempt duration even when artifact reused. Manifest new_work is only work in successful materialization invocation; HyDE invocation new_work includes failed invocations.
accounting_contract.identity: Same-language translation is exact bypass: no call, zero tokens/cost/API duration. Encoding and retrieval still run and incur unpriced compute.
accounting_contract.historical_per_query: Recorded API cost and time, including prior failures and observed provider prompt-cache usage; not a fully cold API or online latency measurement.
accounting_contract.local_reuse: Reusing completed generation causes no new generation API charge; lookup/I/O overhead is not represented by historical generation_seconds. Shared generated outputs reused across eight retrievers and multiple target settings.
accounting_contract.fully_uncached_counterfactual: Charging all recorded input tokens at standard input rate is a pricing sensitivity only; it is not an observed cold-run cost and does not predict latency.
accounting_contract.generation_duration: perf_counter around one non-streaming network request and JSON decoding; sums attempts. Success duration excludes local response schema parsing; failed duration includes failed parsing path. Excludes queue wait, manual retry gaps, cache lookup, model loading and subsequent retrieval.
accounting_contract.encoding_duration: Historical offline embedding build wall time / artifact row count; starts after encoder construction, includes batching/token audit/normalization/output writes and flush. It is not individual query latency.
accounting_contract.retrieval_duration: Historical search/fusion wall time / actual query batch size; includes NumPy exact search and document aggregation, excludes index loading and result serialization. Runtime device=cuda describes embedding config, not this NumPy CPU search.
accounting_contract.pipeline_duration: Sum of measured API attempts plus batch-amortized encoding/search is a component estimate; not measured online end-to-end latency or campaign elapsed time.
accounting_contract.unknown_costs: GPU/CPU/memory/storage, corpus/index preparation, model download/load, Slurm allocations/queues, networking and dataset/question generation are not priced here; not zero.
accounting_contract.billing_limit: Reconciles all locally persisted selected-experiment request files with no omissions or duplicate attempt charges. Does not establish provider-invoiced spend or rule out requests outside this saved local scope.
